head: working-tree
subject: Memory-backed temp files for gRPC control-plane TLS reload tests
change: test_tmp_dir now exposes the temp root and an absolute path helper while keeping the dir/cleanup surface. The xDS control-plane TLS reload tests use it and build absolute CA paths, so their bootstrap file reload no longer reads a file from the congested shared disk under a 3-second deadline.

tests.unit: src/internal/test_tmp_dir.zig checks the memory-backed root and path helper.

notes: The reload tests now use absolute certificate paths, which bootstrap also accepts for normal deployments.
